cues.en: Imagine living in a city

cues.zh: 你买得起漂亮的

cues.en: homes.
cues.zh: 住宅。

cues.en: A city that combines
cues.zh: 一座将

cues.en: quality

cues.en: with affordability.
cues.zh: 与负担得起完美结合的城市。

cues.en: Around the world, this idea of a livable city increasingly
cues.zh: 放眼全球，这种宜居城市的理念越来越

cues.en: seems like a pipe dream.
cues.zh: 像是一个白日梦。

cues.en: Housing and affordability is not just a crisis for The United States. You see it in cities as diverse as Caracas,
cues.zh: 住房与可负担性不仅仅是美国的危机。你在加拉加斯、

cues.en: Moscow, Rio De Janeiro.
cues.zh: 莫斯科、里约热内卢等风格迥异的城市都能看到这一点。

cues.en: The UN estimates that despite the pandemic, over 60% of the world's population will live in cities by 2030.
cues.zh: 联合国预计，尽管经历了疫情，到2030年仍将有超过60%的世界人口生活在城市中。

cues.en: Urbanization is going to keep growing at a tremendous rate. And so we're really going to need to look at how do we build in a manner that's livable, that's affordable.
cues.zh: 城市化进程将继续以惊人的速度增长。因此，我们真的需要思考，该如何以宜居且负担得起的方式进行建设。

cues.en: There is somewhere though that seems to be keeping the housing crisis at bay.
cues.zh: 不过，确实有个地方似乎将住房危机挡在了门外。

cues.en: The Austrian capital Vienna is one of the most affordable major cities in the world. It also tops the charts for quality of life,
cues.zh: 奥地利首都维也纳是世界上生活成本最可负担的大城市之一。它还在生活质量排行榜上名列前茅，

cues.en: and how they got there may offer up some tips for cities globally.
cues.zh: 他们取得这一成就的方式或许能为全球城市提供一些借鉴。

cues.en: This is Aspern Zeystadt in the suburbs of Vienna,
cues.zh: 这里是维也纳郊区的阿斯珀恩湖城（Aspern Seestadt），

cues.en: one of the largest new urban developments currently under construction in Europe. Zeystadt is being built on a former airfield and has a man made swimming lake at its center.
cues.zh: 是欧洲目前在建最大规模的新城市开发项目之一。湖城是在一个前机场旧址上建设的，中心有一个人工游泳湖。

cues.en: of the apartments built here will be allocated to affordable housing,
cues.zh: 建成的公寓将被分配为保障性住房，

cues.en: some of which are designed by their occupants.
cues.zh: 其中一些甚至由住户亲自参与设计。

cues.en: We all know how tough it is to bring new urban quarters to life, to make them feel like the old parts of the city that have this patina that we all love. So we introduce
cues.zh: 我们都知道，要让新的城市街区焕发生机、让他们拥有老城区那种我们都喜爱的岁月沉淀感是多么困难。所以我们引入了

cues.en: a new model of collaborative housing.
cues.zh: 一种合作住房的新模式。

cues.en: Self developed multifamily housing originated in Berlin and Freiburg,
cues.zh: 自建多户住宅起源于柏林和弗赖堡，

cues.en: sort of emanating from the squatters movements. These are groups of people and oftentimes

cues.zh: 他们将致力于设计和建造自己的多户住宅。

cues.en: Collaborative housing is one of the innovative ways subsidized apartments are being built in Vienna.

cues.zh: 在一个保障房小区里。

cues.en: What is very important about these projects is that they think about so many things. They will introduce regularly

cues.en: But the most important part is that these people that have worked together on designing their own apartments and their own building form a community, a lively community.
cues.zh: 但最重要的一点是，这些共同设计自己的公寓和建筑的人们，组成了社区，一个充满活力的社区。

cues.en: So we have found out that they work as a community magnet,

cues.en: Vienna is growing rapidly, and to meet the demand every year, it builds at least 7,000 affordable housing units,

cues.en: Public housing blocks, which are apartments that belong entirely to the city of Vienna, are just one part of the affordable housing portfolio.
cues.zh: 维也纳市政府完全拥有的公共住宅公寓，只是其经济适用房组合的一部分。

cues.en: The city's been building them at a steady pace since the nineteen twenties.
cues.zh: 自20世纪20年代以来，这座城市一直在以稳健的步伐建造它们。

cues.zh: 在90年代，维也纳也对公共住房做出了激进的决策，

cues.zh: 那里的公共住房向来维护良好、品质过硬，

cues.zh: 但为了最大化投资回报，维也纳决定转向另一种模式：补贴私营非营利机构，去建设所谓的“社会住房”。

cues.en: historical
cues.zh: 既有的

cues.en: land reserves,

cues.en: at a very, very low
cues.zh: 而且价格

cues.en: The companies get subsidized loans for construction.
cues.zh: 这些企业能拿到低息的建设贷款。

cues.zh: 如果公寓租金依然偏高，政府还会给租客发放补贴。

cues.en: What is special about Vienna is that social housing is a middle class subsidy.
cues.zh: 维也纳的独特之处在于，社会住房实际上是一项面向中产阶级的福利。

cues.zh: 人们普遍认为它其实适合所有人。

cues.en: And as your income increases, as you get older, you aren't pushed out of your social housing. And what this does is it it keeps people in these communities. So it's a very, different way of of looking at keeping communities intact.

随着收入增加，随着你年龄变大，你不会被赶出保障性住房。

cues.en: Vienna's model isn't a solution that can easily be copy and pasted,
cues.zh: 维也纳的模式并不是那种可以轻松复制粘贴的解决方案，

cues.en: but other cities are paying attention.
cues.zh: 但其他城市正在关注。

cues.en: It will take more than just changes in policy though.
cues.zh: 不过，光靠政策调整是不够的。

cues.en: Attitudes about how and where we live will need to shift too.
cues.zh: 我们对居住方式和地点的观念也需要转变。

cues.en: In The US, there's a lot of desire to live in a detached house, own a single car. For families like mine where we don't own a car,
cues.zh: 在美国，很多人渴望住在独立住宅里，拥有一辆私家车。对于像我们这样没有车的家庭来说，

cues.en: we have two children, we get around by bike, it's density,
cues.zh: 我们有两个孩子，靠自行车出行，正是高密度，

cues.en: and ample social housing that really allows,
cues.zh: 以及充足的公共住房，才真正支撑了

cues.en: for that kind of lifestyle.
cues.zh: 这种生活方式。

cues.en: There is this generational flip where families like ours and and especially those that are younger than us, have no shot at affordable housing or market rate housing in a lot of cities. And I think that we're going to see places really start to look at adding a density and hopefully in a smart way that doesn't bring more cars, more congestion,
